text:
maya: Quick heads-up — started seeing a regression in batch formation after yesterday's kernel selector change.
sam: Ah, what metrics? p95 or throughput?
maya: batch_util down ~11% across p50 GPUs, median batch_size dropped from 8.6 -> 6.9. token/sec is down ~9%. p95 latency up ~120ms. KV cache hitrate also dipped from 82% -> 68% for long-context workloads.
jia: interesting. did the kernel change affect memcpy or staging? any flamegraphs?
maya: I ran a quick profile on the repro pod. flame graph shows added memcpy in attention kernel during kv fetch path; also more time in `queue_wait_ns` before kernel dispatch. link: https://perf.redwood/internal/flames/3023456789
sam: could be that kernel choice changed execution layout and invalidated some batching async path.
maya: hypothesis: new kernel picks different buffer alignment which causes extra copy when KV cache returns partial tensors -> increases queue time and reduces coalescing.
jia: we should add these signals to dashboards: per-batch kernel_id, per-batch kv_misses, batch_formation_wait_ms, effective_batch_tokens, tokens_per_sec, queue_depth_p50/p95. Also a counter for kernel_fallbacks.
maya: agreed. quick prometheus queries I ran:
```
rate(batch_formed_total[5m])
avg_over_time(batch_size{model="redwood-v2"}[5m])
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (kernel_id)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kernel_queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
sam: can we tag the trace with `kernel_id` and `kv_hit=true/false` so we can pivot in tracing UI?
jia: yea I'll add labels and a new dashboard panel. also suggest a small rollout: pin older kernel for 10% traffic and compare batch_util and token/sec for A/B.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollback-pin-old-kernel -> canary=10% at 3023456800 by @deploy-bot :gear:
maya: thanks. i'll produce a short repro script and sample payloads (long context chat & embedding-heavy) and post in thread.
jia: i'll sketch the dashboard panels and PR the metric labels. should we also surface per-kernel KV miss ratio in the batcher telemetry table?
sam: yes, that would help root cause. if A/B shows older kernel doesn't regress then we merge rollback.
maya: tagging @eng-sre for visibility :eyes:
